title: 群成为集合的运动规则
A group as rules for motion
text: 左作用是映射 G×X→X，满足单位元与复合兼容两条公理。每个 g 都给出 X 的一个双射，逆变换由 g⁻¹ 给出。
A left action is a map G×X→X satisfying identity and composition laws. Each g acts bijectively, with inverse given by g⁻¹.
example: D₄ 作用在正方形的顶点集，也可作用在边集、对角线集。改变作用对象，即使群不变，轨道与稳定子也会改变。
D₄ acts on vertices, edges or diagonals of a square. Changing the acted-on set changes orbits and stabilizers.

title: 作用等价于置换表示
Actions and permutation representations
text: 令 ρ(g)(x)=g·x。作用公理正是 ρ 保乘法的条件。核由固定每个点的元素组成；核平凡的作用叫忠实作用。
Set ρ(g)(x)=g·x. The action law says exactly that ρ is a homomorphism. Its kernel consists of elements fixing every point; a trivial kernel means a faithful action.
proof: 作用给出的每个 ρ(g) 可逆，且 ρ(gh)=ρ(g)ρ(h)，所以得到同态。
Each action map is invertible and ρ(gh)=ρ(g)ρ(h), giving a homomorphism.
反向，从同态定义 g·x=ρ(g)(x)，单位元与复合公理直接成立。
Conversely define g·x=ρ(g)(x); the homomorphism laws give both action axioms.
example: 左正则作用 G↷G 总是忠实的；平凡作用 g·x=x 的核是整个 G。
The left regular action is always faithful, while a trivial action has kernel G.

title: 轨道与稳定子
Orbits and stabilizers
text: 轨道回答“x 能走到哪里”；稳定子回答“哪些运动把 x 留在原位”。稳定子是子群，轨道给出 X 的分类。
An orbit records where x can move; its stabilizer records the motions leaving it fixed. Stabilizers are subgroups and orbits partition X.
proof: e 固定 x；若 a,b 固定 x，则 b⁻¹ 也固定 x，故 ab⁻¹ 固定 x，稳定子满足子群判别。
Identity fixes x, and if a,b fix x then ab⁻¹ fixes x, proving the subgroup criterion.
“y=g·x 对某个 g 成立”是等价关系：用 e、g⁻¹、复合分别验证反身、对称、传递。
Reachability is an equivalence relation: use e, inverses and composition for its three properties.

title: 轨道—稳定子定理
The orbit–stabilizer theorem
text: 这里 G/Gₓ 首先表示左陪集集合，不要求 Gₓ 正规。有限群时 |G|=|Gx|·|Gₓ|。
Here G/Gₓ means a left-coset set, not necessarily a quotient group. For finite G, |G|=|Gx|·|Gₓ|.
proof: 良定义：gGₓ=hGₓ 意味着 h⁻¹g 固定 x，所以 g·x=h·x。
Equal cosets mean h⁻¹g fixes x, so g·x=h·x.
单射：反过来，g·x=h·x 意味着 h⁻¹g∈Gₓ，所以两个陪集相同。
Conversely, equal images imply h⁻¹g∈Gₓ and hence equal cosets.
满射：轨道中的点按定义都形如 g·x。由此得到双射及计数公式。
Every orbit point is g·x by definition, proving surjectivity and the counting formula.

title: 共轭作用与类方程
Conjugation and the class equation
text: 取作用 g·x=gxg⁻¹。轨道是共轭类，稳定子是中心化子。单元素共轭类恰是中心元素；求和遍历所有非中心共轭类的一个代表。
For g·x=gxg⁻¹, the orbits are conjugacy classes and stabilizers are centralizers. Singleton classes are central elements; the sum uses one representative of each noncentral class.
proof: g 固定 x ⇔ gxg⁻¹=x ⇔ gx=xg，因此 Gₓ=C_G(x)。
The stabilizer equation gxg⁻¹=x is equivalent to gx=xg.
轨道—稳定子定理给出共轭类大小 [G:C_G(x)]。类大小为 1 当且仅当 x∈Z(G)。
Orbit–stabilizer gives the class size. The class is a singleton exactly for central elements.
把 G 按所有共轭类分块相加，得到类方程。
Sum the sizes of the disjoint conjugacy classes.

title: 有限 p 群的中心非平凡
The center of a finite p-group
text: 非平凡有限 p 群的中心至少含 p 个元素。这是类方程把群结构转化为整除问题的典型应用。
A nontrivial finite p-group has at least p central elements. The class equation turns a structural question into divisibility.
proof: 非中心共轭类大小是大于 1 的 p 的幂：它是 |G| 除以某个子群阶。
A noncentral class has size a power of p greater than 1, by orbit–stabilizer and Lagrange.
所以类方程中非中心项都被 p 整除；|G| 也被 p 整除，因而 p∣|Z(G)|。
Every noncentral term and |G| are divisible by p; so is |Z(G)|.
e∈Z(G)，中心非空，因此其阶不可能为 0，至少为 p。
The center contains e and is nonempty, hence its positive order is at least p.
example: 进一步：p² 阶群一定交换。若中心仅 p 阶，则 G/Z(G) 为 p 阶循环群；而 G/Z(G) 循环会迫使 G 交换，矛盾。
Consequently groups of order p² are abelian. Otherwise the center would have order p and G/Z(G) would be cyclic, forcing G abelian.
extraProof: 若 G/Z(G)=⟨aZ(G)⟩，任意 x=aⁱz、y=aʲw，其中 z,w 在中心；于是 xy=aⁱ⁺ʲzw=yx。
If G/Z(G) is generated by aZ(G), write x=aⁱz and y=aʲw with central z,w; then xy=yx.

title: 用不动点数轨道
Counting orbits by fixed points
text: 有限群作用在有限集上，轨道数等于每个群元素的不动点个数的平均值。计数前必须明确“哪种对称视为等价”。
For a finite group acting on a finite set, the orbit count is the average number of fixed points. Specify which symmetries count as equivalences before counting.
proof: 计算集合 T={(g,x):g·x=x} 的大小。先固定 g，得 |T|=∑g |Fix(g)|。
Count pairs (g,x) with g·x=x by first fixing g.
再固定 x，得 |T|=∑x |Gₓ|。一个轨道中稳定子的阶相同，每个轨道贡献 |Gx|·|Gₓ|=|G|。
Counting by x gives ∑x|Gₓ|. Stabilizers along an orbit have equal size, so each orbit contributes |G|.
故 ∑g |Fix(g)|=|X/G|·|G|，两边除以 |G|。
Equate the counts and divide by |G|.

title: 正方形二色着色
Two-colorings of a square
text: 用两种颜色给四个顶点着色，允许整体旋转与反射。有 16 种带标号着色；按 D₄ 的对称合并后有 6 类。
Color four vertices with two colors, identifying rotations and reflections. There are 16 labeled colorings and six orbits under D₄.
example: 一个置换固定着色，当且仅当同一轮换内的顶点颜色相同。因此含 c 个轮换的置换固定 2ᶜ 种二色着色。只允许旋转 C₄ 时，此例也得到 6 类，但一般并不相同。
A coloring is fixed exactly when colors are constant on permutation cycles. A permutation with c cycles fixes 2ᶜ two-colorings. Rotations alone also give six here, but not in general.

title: 陪集作用连接群与置换
Coset actions connect groups to permutations
text: 任意子群 H 给出陪集作用；H 不必正规。指数越小，得到的置换表示维度越小，可以用来限制群结构。
Any subgroup gives an action on its left cosets, without requiring normality. Small index yields a small permutation representation and strong structural restrictions.
proof: 若 aH=bH，则 (ga)H=(gb)H，故作用良定义；作用公理来自 G 的结合律。
Equal cosets remain equal after left multiplication; associativity gives the action law.
g 固定每个 aH 当且仅当 a⁻¹ga∈H 对所有 a 成立。因此作用核是 ⋂a aHa⁻¹。
An element fixes every coset exactly when a⁻¹ga∈H for all a; the kernel is the intersection of all conjugates of H.
这个核是包含在 H 内的最大正规子群。取 H={e} 就恢复凯莱的正则表示。
This is the largest normal subgroup contained in H. For H={e}, it recovers Cayley’s regular representation.

question: D₄ 作用在正方形顶点上，一个顶点的稳定子阶为？
For D₄ acting on square vertices, what is a vertex stabilizer order?
reason: 轨道有 4 个顶点，|D₄|=8，所以稳定子阶为 2。
The orbit has four points and |D₄|=8, so the stabilizer has order two.

question: 共轭作用中 x 的稳定子是？
What is the stabilizer of x under conjugation?
reason: gxg⁻¹=x 等价于 gx=xg，正是中心化子的定义。
The stabilizer equation is equivalent to commuting with x.

question: 非平凡有限 p 群的中心至少有多少个元素？
How many elements must the center of a nontrivial finite p-group have?
reason: 类方程给出 p∣|Z(G)|，而中心非空，故至少为 p。
The class equation gives p∣|Z(G)|, and the center is nonempty.

question: 正方形四顶点二色着色，允许 D₄ 对称，轨道数为？
How many two-coloring orbits of square vertices are there under D₄?
reason: 不动点总数为 48，除以群阶 8 得 6。
The fixed-point counts sum to 48; divide by eight.

question: 给出一个传递但不忠实的作用，并计算其核。
Give a transitive but nonfaithful action and compute its kernel.
reason: C₄=ℤ/4ℤ 作用在 ℤ/2ℤ 上：[k]·[x]=[k+x] mod 2。它传递，因为 [1] 交换两个点；核是 {[0],[2]}。
Let C₄ act on ℤ/2ℤ by addition modulo 2. It is transitive and has kernel {[0],[2]}.
